messages:
Marta G.: quick sync — need to lock MDF floor and partner tier eligibility before this QBR. proposing a $10k minimum MDF floor for FY next quarter, with SI integration exceptions. thoughts? :eyes:
Kevin Liu: curious — is the $10k floor across the board or only for marketplace/co-marketed partners? also can we tie tiers to marketplace activity + pipeline influence?
Samir Patel: $10k seems ok if we gate it with activity. suggestion: require 3 co-marketed deals or 2 validated integrations for exception. marketplace-only partners get a 6mo runway rule.
Elaine R.: Finance OK in principle but need a quick P&L simulation. please get me candidate counts and expected uptake. @ops-bot add this to QBR agenda.
ops-bot: Added to Partnerships QBR agenda as "MDF floor & tiering" (ticket PRT-4821).
Kevin Liu: rough eligibility matrix draft:
```
Tier A: >= $250k influenced ARR OR >= 10 marketplace listings
Tier B: 50k-250k influenced ARR OR 3-9 listings
Tier C: <50k influenced ARR AND 1-2 listings => pilot MDF only
SI exceptions: validated SI integration + >=2 joint proofs-of-value => discretionary MDF
```
Kevin Liu: also recommend requiring a short joint announcement readiness checklist (tech integration, comms plan, exec sponsor).
Marta G.: good structure. can someone assemble a 1-pager and candidate partner list? I'll pull into the QBR pack by EOD Wed.
Samir Patel: I can export marketplace activity + partner pipeline tags by Tue AM.
Elaine R.: I'll run budget sims for 50/100/150 partner scenarios and post numbers by Tue EOD.
Kevin Liu: I'll draft the announcement rubric tomorrow morning and share for comment.
Marta G.: action items: Samir export (Tue AM), Elaine budget sim (Tue EOD), Kevin rubric (Wed AM), Marta compile 1-pager + QBR slide (Wed EOD). :white_check_mark:
Kevin Liu: +1, happy to pre-review the slide before QBR.
Marta G.: thanks team — pausing thread until deliverables land.
